One person was booked into the Webb County Jail on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, on an alleged federal violation, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search. An arrest is an allegation, and the person is presumed innocent unless proven guilty.

Josefina Hernandez

Hernandez was booked on an alleged federal violation. The booking record did not specify the charge class, and no bond amount or case number was listed. The warrant type is listed as an Other Agency Hold, and the arrest was made by U.S. Customs and Border Protection. The record showed an active-warrant indicator.
